campaign.name: Perfumarte AI Art Direction
campaign.objective: Generate two visually coherent premium campaign images for Corazón de Naranjo (GEI), translating its luminous red-fruit opening, powdery floral heart and elegant feminine softness into a refined visual story.

visual_relationship.rule: Both images must represent the same fragrance concept and olfactive identity, using the same selected botanical elements, powdery atmosphere, color family and emotional tone while developing distinct compositions.

physical_scale_system.scale_reference: Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
physical_scale_system.element_scale_rule: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.relative_scale: Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
physical_scale_system.artistic_scale_override: Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

fragrance_data.name: Corazón de Naranjo (GEI)
fragrance_data.description:
Corazón de Naranjo (GEI): un perfume atalcado de mujer elegante, empolvado y diferente

Corazón de Naranjo (GEI) es un perfume atalcado de mujer pensado para quienes buscan una fragancia original, elegante y con mucha personalidad. Su composición combina la delicadeza de las flores con el dulzor de las bayas rojas, creando un aroma empolvado, sofisticado y muy femenino.

Este perfume atalcado de mujer destaca por el equilibrio entre la violeta y la rosa, dos flores que aportan una sensación suave y aterciopelada, perfecta para quienes disfrutan de perfumes distintos y con una identidad propia.

 

 

¿A qué huele Corazón de Naranjo (GEI), el perfume atalcado de mujer que sorprende por su elegancia?

Corazón de Naranjo (GEI) es un perfume atalcado de mujer donde las notas florales empolvadas se combinan con un toque afrutado, creando una fragancia delicada, envolvente y muy elegante.

Una salida afrutada y luminosa

La fragancia comienza con el dulzor de las bayas rojas, aportando un inicio afrutado, jugoso y ligeramente dulce que llena el perfume de vitalidad y frescura.

Un corazón floral, empolvado y sofisticado

El corazón está protagonizado por la violeta y la rosa, una combinación clásica que aporta un carácter elegante, femenino y atalcado. Estas notas crean una sensación suave y refinada que define la personalidad del perfume.

Un fondo delicado, elegante y duradero

El secado mantiene la armonía entre las notas florales y empolvadas, dejando una estela suave, envolvente y muy agradable que permanece durante horas sobre la piel.

olfactive_translation.principle: Translate the fragrance into a visual story rather than literally representing every listed note.
selection_rules: Select only the most visually expressive olfactive elements.
Prioritize elements that communicate the fragrance identity.
Do not visually represent every listed note by default.
Atmospheric notes may be represented through color, texture, material, smoke, light or environment.
Never introduce ingredients that are not supported by the fragrance data.
The selected visual elements must work coherently across both campaign images.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Juicy, sweet and luminous fruity opening.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several natural clusters of small red berries, including whole berries, translucent cut berries and a few loose berries with realistic stems and subtle moisture.
selected_visual_notes.reason: They communicate the immediate sweetness, vitality and distinctive fruity signature without requiring oversized fruit.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Abundant low foreground and midground clusters framing the bottle, with a few cut berries adding tactile gloss and controlled crimson accents.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A controlled stream of suspended berries and tiny droplets crossing the depth of the scene, integrated into the atmospheric movement without forming an artificial geometric ring.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Luminous floral bridge and subtle orange-blossom identity.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Small clusters of delicate white orange blossoms with green leaves and fine natural stems, accompanied by restrained warm citrus light.
selected_visual_notes.reason: It gives visual meaning to the perfume name and adds freshness while remaining physically delicate in relation to the bottle.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Several natural blossom clusters in the midground and background, softly overlapping with foliage but never covering the bottle or label.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: Small blossom clusters and a few detached petals suspended in a warm, softly circulating air current around the bottle, with plausible separation and depth.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Elegant, feminine and velvety floral heart.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Natural pale blush and dusty pink rose heads, partially open roses and a few petals with realistic folds and imperfections.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Rose provides the campaign’s primary feminine elegance and a tactile velvety texture that supports the powdery character.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: One principal rose cluster placed beside and slightly behind the bottle, supported by several smaller heads and petals across the midground.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A few rose petals drifting slowly through the environment while intact roses remain structurally grounded in distant botanical clusters, preserving natural solid-object behavior.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Powdery, soft and distinctive floral signature.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Small violet flowers in restrained purple tones, delicate green stems and a fine veil of violet-tinted powdery haze.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Violet is essential to the perfume’s recognizable empolvado personality and introduces a refined cool counterpoint to the red fruit and blush rose.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: Moderate grouped violet stems placed near the bottle base and in the background, with powdery matte texture rather than excessive color saturation.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A subtle violet powder mist and a few naturally suspended violet blossoms create the central atmospheric current without obscuring the bottle.

selected_visual_notes.olfactive_role: Bright citrus lift and freshness in the opening.
selected_visual_notes.visual_representation: Several small realistic bergamot fruits, pale green-yellow rind fragments and fine glossy zest details, kept smaller than the bottle and naturally grouped.
selected_visual_notes.reason: Bergamot adds a luminous citrus facet that balances the sweet berries and powdery florals, while its rind offers a useful tactile material.
selected_visual_notes.editorial_use: A restrained cluster in the foreground or side of the surface, with one cut fruit and scattered zest providing controlled luminosity.
selected_visual_notes.surreal_use: A few thin zest curls and fine citrus droplets moving through the air current, while whole bergamots remain in a distant environmental cluster.

shared_visual_identity.concept: El corazón empolvado de un jardín de naranjo: una corriente luminosa de bayas rojas, azahar, rosa y violeta envuelta en una atmósfera de polvo aterciopelado.
shared_visual_identity.emotional_goal: Convey distinctive feminine elegance, soft sensuality and an unexpected balance between juicy red fruit and refined powdery florals.
key_materials: gold cap and label details from the reference bottle
shared_visual_identity.environmental_identity: A refined botanical atelier or intimate sunlit conservatory suggested through soft citrus-filtered light, powdery air, muted floral shadows and layered natural materials.

editorial_still_life.concept: Un bodegón editorial de alta perfumería en un atelier botánico luminoso, donde la botella permanece vertical sobre una superficie real y estable, rodeada por agrupaciones abundantes pero ordenadas de bayas rojas, rosas, violetas, azahar y bergamota.

environment.type: botanical atelier with a matte mineral surface
environment.description: A warm ivory-stone tabletop with subtle powdery texture, a softly graduated wall behind it and diffused daylight passing through an unseen citrus garden. The bottle stands completely vertical at the center-right or central visual axis, stable and unobstructed. Ingredient richness concentrates in low foreground and midground groupings, while the upper and lateral background retains generous negative space for Spanish typography.
environment.background_rule: The environment may be a studio wall, architectural setting, elegant interior, natural landscape, stone setting or other appropriate environment depending on the fragrance.

visual_elements: fully visible exact reference bottle standing vertically
abundant but realistic red berry clusters in foreground and midground
one or two naturally grouped dusty pink rose arrangements
delicate white azahar clusters with green stems
a restrained bergamot cluster with one cut fruit and natural zest
subtle violet powder resting on the surface and suspended in the backlight
soft botanical shadows and muted sage foliage

composition.negative_space: Generous clean space in the upper-left or upper-right quadrant for Spanish typography, with no text crossing the bottle or key ingredients.
composition.depth: Clear foreground, midground and background: close berries and zest softly defocused, the bottle and principal floral group in sharp focus, distant azahar and violet clusters fading into the wall.
composition.bottle_priority: Highest; the bottle is the only product, fully visible, vertically stable, sharply rendered and visually separated from every ingredient.

lighting.style: premium commercial photography with soft botanical daylight
lighting.direction: Large diffused light from upper left, with a gentle warm rim on the bottle and controlled fill from the front.
lighting.contrast: Moderate-low overall contrast with precise highlights on glass, berries and citrus rind; soft mauve shadows preserve the powdery mood.

elements: Una armonía de bayas rojas, rosa y violeta
rules: Typography must never cover the perfume bottle.
Text must integrate naturally with the composition.
Do not overload the image with text.
Place typography only in the intentionally preserved negative space.

immersive_surreal.concept: La botella suspendida dentro de una corriente aérea de polvo violeta y luz de azahar, atravesada por bayas rojas, pétalos y destellos cítricos en un jardín atmosférico físicamente coherente.

environment.description: A dimensional twilight-to-dawn botanical space built from a shallow mineral plane in the lower background, soft violet haze, distant orange-blossom branches and warm filtered light. The bottle floats near the visual centre on the primary compositional axis, fully visible and clearly separated, with the cap subtly displaced left and the base subtly displaced right at a fixed 8-degree tilt. Foreground berries, petals and bergamot zest pass close to the lens; the main flowers occupy the midground; hazy azahar and violet foliage create a continuous background extending to the image edges.

visual_elements: one exact reference bottle, fully visible and tilted 8 degrees with cap left and base right
foreground red berries close to camera with realistic partial cropping and shallow blur
midground clusters of dusty pink roses and violet flowers
small suspended white azahar blossoms with natural stems
a restrained distant bergamot cluster and a few physically plausible citrus droplets
fine violet powder and translucent atmospheric haze flowing around, never across, the bottle
soft mineral fragments and botanical shadows in the lower environment
warm champagne light interacting with the glass and suspended particles

composition.style: dynamic asymmetrical composition with a central suspended hero and directional atmospheric flow
composition.depth: Strong foreground, midground and background separation with medium-shallow focus; close berries and petals partially blurred, bottle sharply focused, distant blossoms softened by haze.
composition.bottle_priority: Highest; the single bottle remains the dominant central focal point, completely recognizable, unobstructed and separated from all moving elements.
composition.negative_space: Controlled atmospheric breathing room around the bottle, with no large empty voids and no ingredient crossing the cap, label or silhouette.

lighting.style: cinematic commercial lighting with luminous botanical atmosphere
lighting.direction: Warm directional key light from upper left and behind, cool violet fill from lower right, with a restrained rim defining the bottle silhouette.
lighting.contrast: Moderate dramatic contrast with controlled highlights on glass and berries, deep but open violet shadows and no crushed detail.
